description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to secure socket communication, including certificate management, key handling, certificate store, and a secure socket port with SSL/TLS functionality within the Thunder::Crypto namespace.

classes.name: Certificate
classes.description: Represents an X.509 certificate, providing methods to access issuer, subject, validity period, and hostname validation.

classes.name: Key
classes.description: Handles cryptographic keys, supporting initialization from key structures or files, with or without passwords.

classes.name: CertificateStore
classes.description: Manages a store of X.509 certificates, allowing addition of certificates and providing a default store.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort
classes.description: Implements a secure socket port with SSL/TLS support, including certificate validation, data transmission, and connection management.

classes.name: SecureSocketServerType<CLIENT>
classes.description: Template class for a secure socket server, holding server certificate and key, inheriting from Core::SocketServerType.

methods.name: Certificate::Issuer
methods.description: Returns the issuer name of the certificate.

methods.name: Certificate::Subject
methods.description: Returns the subject name of the certificate.

methods.name: Certificate::ValidFrom
methods.description: Returns the start of the certificate's validity period.

methods.name: Certificate::ValidTill
methods.description: Returns the end of the certificate's validity period.

methods.name: Certificate::ValidHostname
methods.description: Checks if the certificate is valid for the expected hostname.

methods.name: CertificateStore::Add
methods.description: Adds a certificate to the store.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate
methods.description: Sets the certificate and key for the secure socket port.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Root
methods.description: Sets the root certificate store for the secure socket port.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Open
methods.description: Opens the secure socket connection, waiting up to the specified time.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Close
methods.description: Closes the secure socket connection, waiting up to the specified time.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::SendData
methods.description: Sends data through the secure socket.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::ReceiveData
methods.description: Receives data from the secure socket.
